name: Urea CO2 stripper
description: High-pressure column that strips unconverted carbamate from the urea solution using feed CO2 as the stripping agent, decomposing carbamate and returning ammonia and CO2 to the condenser. CO2 stripping cut the steam demand of urea plants relative to conventional total-recycle designs.
applications: urea synthesis, high-pressure loop carbamate recovery

specifications.basis: CO2-stripping process, effluent conditions as stated
CO2-stripping process, effluent conditions as stated

specifications.metric: residual carbamate in stripper outlet solution

specifications.basis: steam used per tonne of urea in the stripping section

sources.note: Patent WO2017097981A1 (CO2-stripping effluent pressure, temperature and residual carbamate), read 2026-11-17

notes: Urea licensors use different stripping agents — CO2 stripping (Stamicarbon, Toyo ACES, Uhde), self-stripping (Casale) and NH3 stripping (Saipem) — so pressure, temperature and steam figures are not interchangeable across processes.

vendor_models.range: CO2 stripping; no medium-pressure recirculation stage downstream
best suited up to 2,300 MTD, or 3,500 MTD with medium-pressure stage
